The facts: The defendant used purchased Apple account info to remotely lock victims' Apple devices, set them to lost mode or erase, making them unusable, then demanded unlock fees. This is akin to extortion? Actually it's "非法获取计算机信息系统数据、非法控制计算机信息系统" maybe "非法获取计算机信息系统数据罪" or "非法控制计算机信息系统罪". Also "敲诈勒索罪" (extortion) because demanding money to unlock. The act of locking devices using remote management is unauthorized access to computer information system, i.e., "非法获取计算机信息系统数据罪" (Article 285) or "非法控制计算机信息系统罪". The typical charge for ransomware-like behavior is "非法获取计算机信息系统数据罪" or "非法控制计算机信息系统罪" plus "敲诈勒索罪". Chinese law: Using computer to lock devices and demand money is considered "非法获取计算机信息系统数据罪" (if they obtain data) or "非法控制计算机信息系统罪" (if they control). The act of remote lock is controlling the system. So charge: "非法控制计算机信息系统罪" (Article 285). Also "敲诈勒索罪" (Article 274). The amount of money is 1150 yuan, which is small. Here 1150 > 1000, so qualifies as "数额较大". So extortion.
